notes.title: A major new update is now available!
notes.content:
We are excited to present the latest game-changing update, version 0.4.0. You can play the demo now on Steam. Prepare yourselves for an unprecedented adventure as we introduce a plethora of exciting novelties that are bound to take your gaming experience to a whole new level💀

Dive into the heart-pounding action with our brand-new game mode, where strategic thinking meets lightning-fast reflexes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/2e88cf1b9269387cd19ca57d20bba1508dcdfd50.jpg

But that's not all – we're introducing a captivating cast of characters that will add depth and diversity to your roster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/8816bf5142dc89e4dc930e1dd7f64de19c372783.jpg

Venture into uncharted territories and conquer formidable new bosses that guard legendary relics. These relics bestow astonishing powers upon your characters, granting you the edge you need to triumph over adversity. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/a1e1daa913dfe8688988c610b789ebd9ca9f678d.jpg

In this update, we've also expanded our deck-building possibilities with an array of new cards that will redefine your tactical choices.

Get ready to face the unknown, adapt your strategies, and embrace the challenges of Cards Survivors! We can't wait to see how you fare against the new challenges, characters, relics, bosses, and cards. Join us now in the demo and prove your mettle in this ever-evolving battle for survival. Your destiny awaits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/6889959bc228468a79306e2356ddb1cbc91032b2.jpg

If you find a bug or you have suggestions, please write to us. You can leave your feedback on the Steam forums and on our Discord server.

Family Devs

Cards Survivors - 0.4.0

ADDED


 Roguelike mode: Climb the tower, ascending its floors through three acts, encountering many enemies, bosses, and events along the way. The paths through each act all lead to a final floor where a challenging boss encounter awaits. The content of each floor and the available paths through each act are procedurally-generated, so each run will be a different experience.
 Characters: 6 characters in total. Each character has their own starting deck and their own starting relic (Only the first character is available in the Demo Version)
 Relics: 30 relics in total. Each relic provides a passive effect during battle. Relics can be found randomly in battles. In roguelike mode, they can also be found in treasures and shops.
 Bosses: 3 in total. Bosses behave differently from other enemies and always drop a relic after defeating them.
 New enemies: 19 in total.
 New cards: 60 in total.
 New achievements: 57 in total.
 New music: 20 songs in total.
 New backgrounds/biomes: 12 in total.


FIXED


 Several minor issues.

notes.title: Cards Survivors participates in the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello community,

We are very proud to announce that Cards Survivors is participating in the Steam Next Fest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/fa64381183cc983ca52c9c63b1ccba08088c3bf0.jpg

This demo is a sneak peak of Cards Survivors, to show you how gameplay works, some mechanics and art of our game. Most of the content is under development and therefore locked, but we hope you can feel its potential.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/7e4a83d3eab3c315aa36628e9c3a20e00707c12d.jpg

If you find a bug or you have suggestions, please write to us. You can leave your feedback on the Steam forums and on our Discord server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989238/eb3b08117dc116761a7a94c14644b74f40adb985.jpg

We are all ears!

Best regards,
Family Devs.

Cards Survivors - 0.3.0

ADDED


 Cards shop.
 Cards are now unlocked by completing achievements.
 By killing enemies you get gold.


UPDATED


 Design of the cards.
 The max energy is now 9, previously 5.
 The cost per card can be up to 6 energy, previously 4.
 Balancing adjustments according to user feedback.
 Thunder: radius of effect increased.


FIXED


 Several minor issues.
